title: Product Manager – Fundamental Data
description:
**Product Manager – Fundamental Data** 




**Location:** 
 Thane/Nashik, Maharashtra
 



**Experience:** 
 6 – 10 Years
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Financial / Corporate / Fundamental Data / Capital Markets
 



  
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager – Fundamental (Corporate) Data to lead and manage our Corporate Data Operations function.
 



  
 



 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in Fundamental / Financial / Corporate Data related to listed companies, along with demonstrated experience managing a team of 15–20 people.
 



  
 



**This is a specialist financial\-data operations role with strong domain experience. Candidates from general MIS, accounting, generic data\-entry, BPO or non\-financial operations backgrounds will not be considered.** 




  
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 









**Team \& Operations Management** 




 ·        Manage and mentor a team of 15–20 Corporate Data professionals.
 



 ·        Plan workloads, allocate responsibilities and monitor daily productivity and TAT.
 



 ·        Ensure timely and accurate completion of data operations.
 



 ·        Establish and monitor team\-level quality, accuracy and productivity metrics.
 



 ·        Conduct regular performance reviews and identify training/process\-improvement requirements.
 



  
 



**Fundamental / Corporate Data Management** 




 Oversee the ongoing maintenance of current and historical Corporate Data for listed companies.
 



 Manage data relating to:
 



 ·        Quarterly, half\-yearly and annual financial results
 



 ·        P\&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow
 



 ·        EPS, EBITDA, PAT and financial ratios
 



 ·        Shareholding and promoter holdings
 



 ·        Dividends, bonuses, splits, rights issues and other corporate actions
 



 ·        Company master data and classifications
 



 ·        Corporate announcements and company events
 



 ·        Ensure new information is accurately incorporated into existing historical datasets.
 



 ·        Identify and resolve missing, incorrect, duplicate or inconsistent data.
 



  
 



**Data Quality \& Process Management** 




 ·        Establish strong data validation, reconciliation and quality\-control processes.
 



 ·        Monitor data accuracy and ensure adherence to defined data standards and business rules.
 



 ·        Investigate recurring data errors and implement corrective actions.
 



 ·        Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
 



 ·        Coordinate with Product and Technology teams for system and workflow enhancements.
 



  
 



**Sales \& Client Onboarding Support** 




 ·        Assist the Sales Team in onboarding prospective clients with Fundamental/Corporate Data requirements.
 



 ·        Understand client requirements relating to data fields, coverage, history, formats and frequency.
 



 ·        Support Sales during product discussions, demonstrations and data\-related queries.
 



 ·        Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely fulfilment of client data requirements.
 



 ·       Act as a domain expert and bridge between Sales, Data Operations, Product and Technology teams.
 








**Required Skills \& Experience** 




 ·        6 – 10 years of relevant experience in Fundamental Data, Financial Data, Corporate Data, Market Data or a related capital\-markets domain.
 



 ·        Proven experience managing a team of 15–20 people.
 



 ·        Strong understanding of Indian Equity / Capital Markets.
 



 ·        Hands\-on experience handling current and historical Corporate / Fundamental Data.
 



 ·        Strong understanding of listed\-company financial statements and financial results.
 



 ·        Good knowledge of Corporate Actions and Shareholding Data.
 



 ·        Strong data validation, reconciliation and quality\-control skills.
 



 ·        Excellent Excel skills and ability to work with structured datasets.
 



 ·        Strong analytical, problem\-solving and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 ·        Ability to work effectively with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams.
 








**Required Qualifications** 




 ·        Bachelor's/Master's in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or Economics.
 



 ·        6 – 10 years' experience working directly with fundamental/financial data — at a data vendor, research firm, or fintech
 



 ·        Strong command of financial statement analysis, accounting standards (Ind AS/IFRS/GAAP), and corporate actions
 



 ·        Hands\-on experience with financial databases (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, Capital IQ, FactSet, or similar)
 



 ·        Proficiency in SQL for querying and validating large datasets
 



 ·        Exceptional attention to detail with a data\-accuracy\-first mindset
 








**Preferred** 




 ·        Experience with XBRL or structured financial reporting formats
 








**Compensation** 




 Commensurate with experience and in line with industry standards; to be discussed during the interview process.

title: Technical Project Management - Advisor I
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Technical Project Management \- Advisor I
   

  

**What does a successful Programme Manager do at FISERV ?**
 As a Successful Programme Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating complex projects and initiatives that require a deep understanding of technology process and finance.
   

  

 You will be part of Global Business Solutions Group in the Acquiring Space, driving programme for one of the largest banks, financial institutions, and other services in the country, launching new services and managing development and implementation of banking and financial solutions. Being a part of Technology, you will contribute towards building a strong program pipeline in compliance with local regulatory requirements, while collaborating with cross\-functional teams ensuring alignment of program objectives and goals.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
* Develop comprehensive programme plans. objectives and deliverables, ensuring alignment with the overall business strategy.
* Oversee Programme budgets, resource allocation, ensuring adherence to compliance and project plans.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including Business and Portfolio Management, Operations and other relevant departments to define programme requirements, priorities and come up with End to End Program and Project plan.
* Foster Strong relationship with key stakeholders, including senior executives, business leaders and external vendors ensuring effective communication and alignment of programme objectives.
* Provide regular updates and reports on program status, financial performance, risks and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels.
* Lead end\-to\-end program lifecycle, from initiation to closure, ensure effective project planning, execution and monitoring. Coordinate with BA, DEV and BAU teams to track the project to closure.
* Identify and manage risks and issues that may impact program timelines, financials, or deliverables.
* Monitor program progress and performance against established metrics, making necessary adjustments to ensure successful outcomes.


**What Will You Need To Know**
* Proven experience of 10\- 12 years as a Program Manager or similar role within the Financial Services industry.
* Strong knowledge of technology platforms, operations process and Project Management principles within a technology driven environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large\-scale, complex programs with multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on driving results and achieving program objectives
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required, and advanced degree is a plus.
* Team leadership, collaboration, and decisiveness.


**What Would Be Great To Have**
* Project management certifications (PMP / PRINCE2/ CSM) are preferred.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
